rs1426654.description: The derived allele (A) is nearly fixed in Europeans and common in Middle East/South Asia. rs16891982.description: The ancestral allele (C) is common in East Africa, whereas the derived allele is characteristic of Europeans and some West Asians. rs11122334.description: Dravidian Genomic Marker - characteristic of the Southern Indian subcontinent.
